method: Inclusive horizontal centre-range geometry, one-unit midpoint bins, current gun/Arc ranges48/72 and silo ranges72/96/120. Range96 gun is inactive. No LOS/pitch/flight/guaranteed-damage claim; complete routes are measured independently, including the common tail.

options.rationale: A dry western entrance curls around the southwest limestone garden, rises through the wooded western interior and passes the central masonry. A lower-shore encounter then turns around an eastern court before returning beside the southeastern knoll to a separate southern catch. The lake remains uninterrupted scenery, while the route visits both ruin settings and several differently shaped courts.

A western entrance climbs from the southwest garden into a broad northern woodland court, then crosses the narrower upper part of the mere. The eastern bank bends down toward a central return below the masonry and a southern exit. This makes the lake crossing the transition between early western and late eastern/southern opportunities, at the cost of a more exposed upper shore and a bank-range gap over water.
